description: The only confirmation of who a mention notified is the native title tooltip on a non-focusable <span class='mention'>. Keyboard and touch users cannot see it, and nothing shows delivery state (pending, claimed, acknowledged).
expected: Chips show the recipient's name inline and are focusable, with an accessible description. Ideally a 'Notified: Setup agent (Priya), Cursor reviewer' line under the comment, with delivery state.
actual: A hover-only title. Chips look identical whether or not the agent has picked up the mention.
suggested_fix: Render the display name as chip text; add a per-comment 'Notified …' summary with mention state from model.mentions.

description: Long handle chips break mid-handle across lines ('@agent-04d9f305fe442c1739ad-' / 'cursor') at 1440px and at 390px.
expected: Chips do not wrap internally (or show a short display name).
actual: Wrapped chip backgrounds split across two lines.
suggested_fix: white-space: nowrap on .mention, and shorter chip text (display name).
